promoted_questions.rationale: Official GSET Code 24 Unit VIII (Geographic Thought) covers contributions of scholars and explicitly includes cartography and thematic/methodological contributions. This item asks what exploration and discoveries aimed to develop, with options covering topographic description, cartography and chorography; Unit VIII is the direct syllabus fit. Official syllabus: https://gujaratset.ac.in/assets/syllabus/24.pdf.

Official GSET Code 24 Unit V (Population and Settlement Geography) covers settlement geography, urbanization, internal structure of the city, urban land-use models and changing urban forms. Chandigarh master planning is a direct urban-planning/settlement topic within this unit. Official syllabus: https://gujaratset.ac.in/assets/syllabus/24.pdf.
